population: Prospective approved positively priced indie game with existing English source and new Spanish-Latin-America translation, not a real buyer cohort
unit: One unique translation task-hour log or one aligned event count per locale cohort, never a paid person inferred from page views
period: 2026-10-27 public official guidance; future 7, 30, 90 day measurement horizons contingent on authorized release
sample_frame: Official platform language metadata quality, payment, pricing and indexing docs, selected recent es-419 tagged 2D Paid browse filter
target_selection_basis: Existing discoverable es-419 product category and practical pilot scope, not demonstrated buyer demand
limitations: The 174 public listings are a cached filtered browse result, not verified paid game purchases or an estimate of Spanish-language demand.
Translation effort must be timed by actual future work sessions; no generic words-per-hour or flat translator budget was fabricated.
Language tags must only be enabled after actual translated content is available, as required by official quality guidance.
Different locale audiences and referral mixes invalidate naive causal paid-order comparisons.
No creator account, purchase, translation, game build or cost is observed.
